# Ankush Yadav

> Product builder in India. Designs, builds and ships Android, web and AI applications end to end. Five shipped apps, all running live on this site.

## What he builds
- Android apps: Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, AGSL shaders, accessibility and foreground services, Capacitor, React Native / Expo.
- Web and servers: React, TypeScript, Node.js, Bun, Hono, Express, Socket.IO, PostgreSQL, SQLite with vector search, Firebase.
- AI products: voice assistants, LLM orchestration with Claude and Gemini, on-device models, long-term memory.

## Shipped work (this site)
- Strikedeck: real-time options trading desk for Indian markets. Live broker ticks, engine consensus, safety gate, paper-to-live promotion. React, Express 5, Socket.IO, PostgreSQL, Flutter clients. 1,871 source files, 763 test files.
- Mikazuki: a voice operating system for one person on Android. Wake word, cloud and on-device brains, vector memory, on-phone execution. Kotlin, Compose, Bun, Hono, sqlite-vec.
- Sri Hari Docs: truck paperwork for an agri-trading company. Photograph, extract, match the right truck, complete paper trail. React, Capacitor, Firebase. Hindi and English.
- ShopConnect: offline Android retail demo with four roles and one simulated order. Expo 58, React Native, TypeScript.
- Business toolkit (name withheld until launch): zero-budget programme with research, two-checker fact-checking, a repository validator with 14 tests, and an owner approval gate before any build phase.
